SUBJECT - Murder of Cheng Pang-shek, journalist
and of Liu Kie, his wife (No.64 New Foh Li
Alley, Liu La Joong, Route Say Zoong)
REMARKS - Political murders
activities of Chinese C...U.

Circumstances under which crime was committed

At about 6.20 a.m. on June 8th, the French Police were
informed that a crime had just been committed at No.64 New
Foh Li, Alley Liu La Long, Route Say Zoong. On reaching
the premises, in a room situated on the second floor,
they found, a man and a woman, both of whom had been killed
by pistol shots. The woman was lying stretched on her
back across a bed, and the man was seated in front of his
desk, his head hung back over the back of the chair.
The man had been shot twice, whilst the woman bore traces
of four wounds.

Enquiries were at once started, and consequently the
circumstances under which the crime took place were soon
brought to light.

At about 7.40 a.m. three individuals, of whom two were
carrying baskets of fruits went inside, to House No.64.
The third man remained outside the house. The two
murderers entered the room suddenly, and each one chose
his victim.

The man, who was reading a newspaper at his desk, first
of all received a shot in the back of the head, which caused
him to sink onto the desk, when, before he could rise again
he received a second shot at a very close range, in the

犯罪发生之情形

6月8日上午约6时20分，法国警察接报称，萨宗路刘拉弄新福里64号刚刚发生了一起刑事案件。抵达现场后，在二楼的一个房间内，他们发现一男一女两人均遭枪击身亡。女子仰面横卧在床上，男子则坐在书桌前，头部向后仰靠在椅背上。男子身中两枪，而女子身上有四处的伤痕。

调查随即展开，因此犯罪发生的情形很快便水落石出。

上午约7时40分，有三个人进入64号住宅，其中两人提着水果篮。第三个人留在屋外。两名凶手突然闯入房间，各自选择了自己的目标。

当时正坐在书桌前看报纸的男子，首先后脑勺中了一枪，这使他扑倒在书桌上，在他还没来得及再次起身之前，又在极近的距离内额头中了一枪，

forehead. The woman being wounded by the first shot
tried to run away but was mowed down by four further shots.
Having completed their crime the murderers left the
premises and made good their departure.

Both the arrival and departure of these individuals
was witnessed by one named Zeng Veng Moo ( 陳文茂 ),
age 63, the private alleyway watchman, who is employed
to look after the alleyway and keep it clean. Meanwhile
not noticing anything of suspicious nature about these
persons, he let them out unconcernedly. His attention
was soon afterwards attracted by the cries of a little girl,
who was weeping near the door of No.64. Zung Vee-foo went
into the house, and there on the second floor he saw
a female corpse stretched out on a bed, and a male corpse
still sitting in a chair. He at once hastened to inform
the Police.

According to Zeng, the three individuals wore
Chinese clothes.

The first wore trousers and a short black jacket. He was
above average height, and had black hair, appearing to be
about 25-26 years of age.

The second individual was in like manner dressed in a short
coat and black trousers, and wore a yellow Panama straw hat.
Age about 25-26.

The third individual wore a grey coat and trousers and
a yellow Panama straw hat, age about 24 to 25 years.

The Chief Tenant named Liu Zi-sz ( 刘得氏 ) age 38,
who lives on the ground floor, states that at about 8.15 a.m.
she heard explosions which she though were crackers and
in consequence she did not bother about the matter. Just
as she had started to open her door slightly she saw two
persons coming down the stairs. Being frightened she shut

这些人的到来和离开均被一名叫曾文茂（Zeng Veng Moo，音译：陈文茂）的人目击，他今年63岁，是私人弄堂的看守人，受雇负责照看弄堂并保持清洁。当时他并未察觉这些人有任何可疑之处，便漫不经心地让他们出去了。不久之后，他的注意力被一个在64号门口哭泣的小女孩的哭声所吸引。曾维富（Zung Vee-foo，音译）走进屋内，在二楼看到一具女尸横卧在床上，还有一具男尸仍坐在椅子上。他立即赶去通知警察。

据曾某称，这三个人都穿着中式服装。

第一人穿着裤子和黑色短夹克。他身材高于平均水平，黑发，看起来约25-26岁。

第二个人同样穿着短外套和黑裤子，戴着一顶黄色巴拿马草帽。年龄约25-26岁。

第三个人穿着灰色外套和裤子，戴着一顶黄色巴拿马草帽，年龄约24至25岁。

名叫刘得氏（Liu Zi-sz，音译：刘得氏）的主要租户，38岁，住在一楼，她说上午约8点15分时听到爆炸声，她以为是鞭炮，因此没有在意。就在她刚开始把门打开一点缝时，她看见两个人从楼梯上下来。因受到惊吓，她关上了

Examination of Exhibits

Seven empty 7.65 cases were found on the room where
the crime took place. One on the bed, beside the woman's
head, one on the desk and five on the floor. The
examination by the S.M.P. Arms identification specialist, shows
that one of the pistols used to shoot Cheng Fang-shek and his
previously
wife has been used in the committal of 14 political crimes
during the period from 1928 to 1934, as listed below :-

物证检验

在犯罪发生的房间里发现了七个空的7.65毫米弹壳。一个在床边，靠近女子的头部，一个在书桌上，五个在地板上。经上海公共租界工部局警务处武器鉴定专家检验显示，用于射击程方社及其

Motives of the Crime

Cheng: ang shek (陈孚晨) alias Cheng Yih Jing (陈一民)
alias Chang Teh eng (陈德生) was 28 years of age, and
a native of upch. A former student of the Tsong Hwa
Secondary school, in uchow, he affiliated into the
"Young China Communist League" in 1925. In 1926 he was
sent by the Chinese Communist Party to Moscow, where he
studied at the Sun Yat-sen University. It was during this
stay in the capital of the U.R.S.S. that he married Liu .ie,
ho was also a communist. This marriage resulted in the
birth of a daughter. On his return to China in 1930
cheng changed his name to Cheng Pong-shek. He held the
post of secretary of the Committee for the Kiangsu Provincial
Branch of the Chinese Communist Propaganda Bureau. He
was also an active member of the L.U.L.R. and of the "Chinese
Radical Literature League" (an auxiliary branch of the C.C.P.).
Later he broke off from the C.C.P. Of late he has
contributed articles to several review and papers in Shanghai,
viz. "Central China Daily News", i.e. Wang Ching Wei's organ
called the monthly Lao Kung Yuh Poo Review (劳工月报),
Shanghai ei ao (上海美报), Oriental Review (东方杂志),
etc.

Cheng Pong Shek came to reside at No.64 Zeu oh Li,
Route Say Joong towards the latter part of April 1934. His
previous addresses were as follows :-

1) January 1934 No.9 Sai Hu Li Alley, Ferry Road, residence

犯罪动机

程方社（Cheng: ang shek，中文名：陈孚晨），别名程一静（Cheng Yih Jing，中文名：陈一民），别名陈德生（Chang Teh eng，中文名：陈德生），现年28岁，籍贯苏州。曾是苏州中华中学的学生，于1925年加入“中国共产主义青年团”。1926年，他被中国共产党派往莫斯科，在孙逸仙大学学习。正是在苏联首都停留期间，他与同为共产党员的刘洁（Liu .ie，音译：刘洁）结婚。这段婚姻育有一女。1930年回国后，程改名为程方社（Cheng Pong-shek）。他担任中国共产党宣传部江苏省支部委员会秘书一职。他还是左翼作家联盟（L.U.L.R.）和“中国激进文学联盟”（中国共产党的附属分支）的活跃成员。后来他与中共决裂。最近，他为上海的几种评论和报纸撰稿，即《华中日报》，也就是汪精卫的机关刊物《劳工月报》，以及《上海美报》、《东方杂志》等。

Chen Fang Shek led a very quiet life. He seldom went
out and had no visitors. He would not even allow his
young daughter to play with the neighbours' children. Amongst
Cheng's few acquaintances was one Wang Dao Nan (王道南), age
34, native of Kiangsi, former deputy magistrate for
Kiangse province, who is just now out of work. Wong had studied
together with Cheng at the Tsong Wu School.
These two friends separated in 1923 and it was not till the
end of May 1934, that they met quite by accident in Avenue
Joffre. On Chengs invitation they went and had luncheon
at a Chinese restaurant (Zu Fong Ya) on Chekiang Road. On
leaving, Chen did not tell Wang his address. On June 5 Wang,
wishing to thank Cheng for his invitation to luncheon, sent
him his card, c/o the Tsong Hwa Newspaper, 303 Honan Road, to
ask him to luncheon. Besides Cheng, this luncheon party was
attended by some of Wangs friends, whom he had invited, so as
to request them to find him some employment. None of these
friends had known Cheng before.
Bearing in mind the result of the experts
examination of the bullet cases found on the scene of the crime,
there is every reason to assume that the murder of Cheng and
his wife was the work of agents of the Chinese Communist Party.

陈方社过着非常安静的生活。他很少外出，也没有访客。他甚至不允许自己的小女儿与邻居的孩子玩耍。在程的少数熟人中，有一位叫王道南（Wang Dao Nan，中文名：王道南）的人，34岁，江西人，前江西省副知县，目前失业。王曾与程在中华学校一起读书。
这两位朋友于1923年分手，直到1934年5月底，他们才在霞飞路偶然相遇。应程的邀请，他们去浙江路的一家中国餐馆（祖丰雅，音译）吃了午饭。离开时，程没有告诉王他的地址。6月5日，王为了感谢程请他吃午饭，通过河南路303号中华新闻社转交名片给程，邀请他共进午餐。除了程之外，参加这次午餐的还有王的一些朋友，他邀请他们是想请他们帮他找份工作。这些朋友以前都不认识程。
考虑到专家对犯罪现场发现的弹壳的检验结果，有充分理由假定，程及其妻子被谋杀是中国共产党特工所为。

SUBJECT - Murder of Cheng Fang-shek, journalist
and of Liu Kie, his wife (No.64 Zeu Foh Li
Alley, Liu Ka Loong, Route Say Zoong)

REFERENCE - Political Murders
activities of Chinese G.P.U.

Circumstances under which crime was committed

At about 8.20 a.m. on June 8th, the French Police were
informed that a crime had just been committed at No.64 Zeu
Foh Li, Alley Liu Ka Long, Route Say Zoong. On reaching
the premises, in a room situated on the second floor,
they found, a man and a woman, both of whom had been killed
by pistol shots. The woman was lying stretched on her
back across a bed, and the man was seated in front of his
desk, his head hung back over the back of the chair.
The man had been shot twice, whilst the woman bore traces
of four wounds.

Enquiries were at once started, and consequently the
circumstances under which the crime took place were soon
brought to light.
（印：DEPUTY COM... KmB ...）
At about 7.40 a.m. three individuals, of whom two were
carrying baskets of fruits went inside, to House No.64.
The third man remained outside the house. The two
murderers entered the room suddenly, and each one chose
his victim.

The man, who was reading a newspaper at his desk, first
of all received a shot in the back of the head, which caused
him to sink onto the desk, when, before he could rise again
he received a second shot at a very close range, in the

犯罪发生时的具体情况

6月8日上午8时20分左右，法国警方接到通知，称萨宗路（Route Say Zoong）刘家弄（Liu Ka Long）朱佛里（Zeu Foh Li）64号刚刚发生了一起刑事案件。抵达现场后，在二楼的一个房间内，他们发现一男一女两人，均死于枪击。女子仰面横卧在床上，男子坐在书桌前，头部向后靠在椅背上。男子身中两枪，而女子身上有四处的伤痕。

调查随即展开，因此犯罪发生的具体情况很快便水落石出。
（印章：副督察... KmB ...）
上午7时40分左右，三个人进入64号住宅，其中两人提着水果篮。第三个人留在屋外。两名凶手突然闯入房间，各自选定了目标。

当时正坐在书桌前看报纸的男子，首先后脑勺中了一枪，这使他扑倒在书桌上，在他还没来得及起身之前，又在极近的距离内额头中了第二枪。

Having completed their crime, the murderers left the

Both the arrival and departure of these individuals

According to Zeng, the three individuals wore

The first wore trousers and a short black jacket. He was

The second individual was in like manner dressed in a short

据曾某称，这三个人都穿着中式服装。

第一人穿着裤子和黑色短夹克。他身材高于平均水平，黑发，看起来约25-26岁。

Motives of the Crime
Cheng Fang Shek ( 陳芳君 ) alias Cheng Yih Ming ( 陳一民 )
alias Cheng Teh Seng ( 陳德生 ) was 28 years of age, and
a native of Hupeh. A former student of the Tsong Hwa
Secondary School, in Wuchow, he affiliated into the
"Young China Communist League" in 1925. In 1926 he was
sent by the Chinese Communist Party to Moscow, where he
studied at the Sun Yat-sen University. It was during this
stay in the capital of the U.R.S.S. that he married Liu Kie,
who was also a communist. This marriage resulted in the
birth of a daughter. On his return to China in 1930
Cheng changed his name to Cheng Fang-shek. He held the
post of Secretary of the Committee for the Kiangsu Provincial
Branch of the Chinese Communist Propaganda Bureau. He
was also an active member of the M.O.P.R. and of the Chinese
Radical Writers League" (an auxiliary branch of the C.C.P.)
Later he broke off from the C.C.P. Of late he has
contributed articles to several review and papers in Shanghai,
viz. "Central China Daily News", Mr. Wang Ching Wei's organ
called the monthly Lao Kung Yuh Poo Review ( 勞工月報 ),
Shanghai Mei Pao ( 上海美報 ), Oriental Review ( 東方雜誌 ),
etc.

Cheng Fang Shek came to reside at No.64 Zeu Roh Li,
Route Say Zoong towards the latter part of April 1934. His
previous addresses were as follows :-
1) January 1934 No.9 Sai Hu Li Alley, Ferry Road, residence

程芳社（Cheng Fang Shek）（陳芳君），又名陈一民（Cheng Yih Ming）（陳一民），又名陈德生（Cheng Teh Seng）（陳德生），28岁，湖北人。他曾是梧州中华中学的学生，于1925年加入“中国共产主义青年团”。1926年，他被中国共产党派往莫斯科，在孙逸仙大学学习。正是在苏联首都停留期间，他娶了同为共产党员的刘洁（Liu Kie）。这段婚姻育有一个女儿。1930年回到中国后，程改名为程芳社（Cheng Fang-shek）。他担任中国共产党宣传部江苏省分部委员会秘书一职。他还是国际革命战士救济会（M.O.P.R.）和“中国左翼作家联盟”（中国共产党的附属分支）的活跃成员。后来他与中共断绝关系。最近，他为上海的几家评论刊物和报纸撰稿，如《华中日报》、汪精卫先生的机关刊物月刊《劳工月报》、《上海美报》、《东方杂志》等。

Chen Fang Shek led a very quiet life. He seldom went
out and had no visitors. He would not even allow his
young daughter to play with the neighbours' children. Amongst
Cheng's few acquaintances was one Wang Dao Nan (王道南), age
34, native of Kiangsi, former deputy majestrate for
Kiangse province, who is just now out of work. Wong had studied
together with Cheng at the Tsong Wu School.
These two fiends separated in 1923 and it was not till the
end of May 1934, that they met quite by accident in Avenue
Joffre. On Chengs invitation they went and had luncheon
at a Chinese restaurant (Zu Fong Ya) on Chekiang Road. On
leaving, Chen did not tell Wang his address. On June 5 Wang,
wishing to thank Cheng for his invitation to luncheon, sent
him his card, c/o the Tsong Hwa Newspaper, 303 Honan Road, to
ask him to luncheon. Besides Cheng, this luncheon party was
attended by some of Wangs friends, whom he had invited, so as
to request them to find him some employment. None of these
friends had known Cheng before.
Bearing in mind the result of the experts
examination of the bullet cases found on the scene of the crime,
there is every reason to assume that the murder of Cheng and
his wife was the work of agents of the Chinese Communist Party.

程芳社过着非常安静的生活。他很少外出，也没有访客。他甚至不让自己的小女儿与邻居的孩子玩耍。在程某为数不多的熟人中，有一位王道南（Wang Dao Nan），34岁，江西人，前江西省副法官，目前失业。王曾与程在崇武学校（Tsong Wu School）一起读书。
这两位朋友在1923年分手，直到1934年5月底，他们才在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）偶然相遇。应程的邀请，他们去浙江路的一家中餐馆（祖丰雅（Zu Fong Ya））吃了午餐。离开时，程没有告诉王他的地址。6月5日，王为了感谢程请他吃午餐，通过河南路303号中华新闻社转交名片给程，邀请他共进午餐。除了程之外，参加这次午餐的还有王邀请的一些朋友，目的是请求他们帮他找份工作。这些朋友以前都不认识程。
考虑到专家对犯罪现场发现的弹壳的检验结果，有充分理由认为，程及其妻子的谋杀案是中国共产党特工所为。

Changhai, le 27 Juin 194

SERVICES DE POLICE
SERVICE POLITIQUE

RAPPORT

Objet : assassinat de CHANG-P-NG-SHEK, journaliste
et de LIU-KIS, sa femme (N°64, cité Zeu-Foh-Li,
Liu-Ka-Long, Route Say-Zoong)

Référ : assassinats politiques, activités du C.P.U.Chinois

Circonstances dans lesquelles le crime a été commis -

Le 8 Juin vers 8 h.3., la Police Française était prévenue
qu'un crime venait d'être commis au N°64, cité Zeu-Foh-Li, Liu-
Ka-Long, Route Say-Zoong.

Arrivée sur les lieux, elle trouva dans la chambre située au
2ème étage, un homme et une femme, tués à coups de pistolet. La
femme était étendue sur le dos en travers du lit. L'homme était
H.D./A.O. assis en face de son bureau, la tête renversée sur le dossier de
la chaise.

L'homme avait été tué par deux balles. La femme portait les
traces de quatre blessures.

L'enquête à laquelle il fut aussitôt procédé, a permis de
rétablir comme suit les circonstances dans lesquelles fut perpé-
tré ce crime :

Vers 7 h.40, trois individus dont deux portaient des paniers
de fruits, pénétraient dans la maison N°64. Le troisième restait à
l'extérieur. Pénétrant brusquement dans la chambre, chacun des meur-
triers choisit sa victime. L'homme qui lisait un journal devant
son bureau, reçut d'abord une balle derrière la tête et s'étant
affaissé sur le bureau, il reçut, lorsqu'il se releva, à bout por-
tant, une balle qui l'atteignit au front. La femme blessée d'un
premier coup de feu, chercha à fuir mais fut abattue de quatre
nouveaux coups de feu.

............Leur crime

上海，1934年6月27日

警务处
政治股

报告

事由：记者张方石（CHANG-P-NG-SHEK）及其妻子刘杰（LIU-KIS）被暗杀案（地址：萨宗路刘家弄朱福里64号）

参考：政治暗杀案，中国共产党活动

案发经过——

6月8日约8时30分，法租界巡捕房接报称，萨宗路刘家弄朱福里64号刚发生一起凶杀案。

警员抵达现场后，在二楼房间内发现一男一女两名死者，均系枪击身亡。女子仰面横卧于床上。男子H.D./A.O. 坐在书桌前，头部后仰靠在椅背上。

男子身中两弹身亡。女子身上有四处处伤痕。

经随即展开的调查，查明案发经过如下：

约7时40分，三名男子进入朱福里64号住宅，其中两人提着水果篮。第三人留在屋外。凶手突然闯入房间，各自选定目标。当时正在书桌前看报的男子，先被击中后脑一枪，瘫倒在书桌上；当他试图起身时，又被近距离补射一枪，击中前额。女子先中一枪受伤，试图逃跑，但又被连开四枪击毙。

............他们的罪行

Leur crime accompli, les meurtriers sortirent de la maison
et s'éloignèrent.

L'entrée et la sortie de ces individus fut aperçue par le
nommé CHENG VANG POU (陳文甫), âgé de 63 ans, balayeur de la
cité. Cependant, ne voyant rien de suspect, il les laissa tran-
quillement sortir. Attiré peu après par les cris d'une fillette
qui pleurait près de la porte du N°64, CHENG-VANG-POU entra dans
la maison. C'est là qu'il vit au deuxième étage le cadavre d'une
femme étendue sur le lit et celui d'un homme encore assis sur
une chaise. Il s'empressa immédiatement de prévenir la police.

D'après ZHANG, les trois individus étaient habillés à la chi-
noise. Le premier portait un pantalon et une veste courte noire.
Il était d'une taille au dessus de la moyenne, des cheveux noirs
et paraissait âgé de 25 à 26 ans.

Le deuxième individu portait également une veste courte et
un pantalon noirs. Il était coiffé d'un chapeau de paille jaune
(genre Panama). Il paraissait âgé de 25 à 26 ans.

Le troisième individu avait une veste et un pantalon gris,
un chapeau de paille jaune (genre Panama). Il paraissait âgé de
24 à 25 ans.

La première locataire nommée LIU SI SHI (劉徐氏) (38 ans)
qui occupe la chambre du rez-de-chaussée, déclara avoir entendu
vers 8 h. et quart des détonations. Elle ne s'en inquiéta, ayant
cru qu'il s'agissait de pétards. Au moment où elle entr'ouvrit
sa porte, elle vit deux individus qui descendaient les escaliers.
Prise de peur, elle ferma sa porte. D'après LIU, le premier indi-
vidu était assez grand, visage allongé et maigre paraissant âgé
de 25 à 26 ans, vêtu à la chinoise, veste courte et pantalon noirs,
sans chapeau (cheveux noirs).

L'enquête a révélé que les victimes du crime se nommaient :
l'homme CHENG-FANG-SHEK (陳芳若) alias CHENG-YIH-MING (陳一民)
alias CHENG-TCH-SAN (陳德生), journaliste, et la femme LIU-KIE
(刘傑).

行凶完毕后，凶手离开住宅并逃离现场。

一名叫陈文甫（CHENG VANG POU）的63岁弄堂清洁工目睹了这些人进出住宅的过程。然而，因未觉可疑，他便任由他们平静离开。不久后，陈文甫被朱福里64号门口一名哭泣女孩的叫声吸引，进入屋内。他在二楼看到一具女尸横卧床上，另一具男尸仍坐在椅子上。他立即向警方报案。

据张某称，这三名男子身着中式服装。第一人身穿黑色短褂和黑裤。身材中等偏上，黑发，年龄约25至26岁。

第二人也身穿黑色短褂和黑裤。头戴黄色草帽（巴拿马式）。年龄约25至26岁。

第三人身穿灰色短褂和灰裤，头戴黄色草帽（巴拿马式）。年龄约24至25岁。

住在底楼房间的第一位租客刘徐氏（LIU SI SHI）（38岁）称，她在8点15分左右听到枪声。她并未在意，以为是鞭炮声。当她把门打开一条缝时，看见两个人正走下楼梯。她因恐惧而关上了门。据刘氏称，第一个人身材较高，脸型瘦长，年龄约25至26岁，身着中式服装，穿黑色短褂和黑裤，未戴帽子（黑发）。

调查查明，本案受害者姓名为：男子张方若（CHENG-FANG-SHEK），又名张一民（CHENG-YIH-MING），又名张德生（CHENG-TCH-SAN），记者；女子刘杰（LIU-KIE）。

Examen des pièces à conviction -

Sept douilles de cartouches calibre 7,65 furent trouvées dans
la chambre du crime : l'une sur le lit, à droite de la tête de la
femme, une autre sur le bureau et cinq sur le plancher.
L'expertise, faite par la Police Internationale, a établi que
l'un des pistolets utilisés pour l'assassinat de CHANG-FANG-SHOK
et de sa femme avait déjà servi à commettre 14 crimes politiques
entre 1928 et 1934. En voici la liste :
1/ Attentat organisé le 4 Septembre 1928, contre le nommé JANG-
TSAO-KUIN (王招君), ex-communiste, cité Siang-Foh-Li, Avenue
Road.
2/ Assassinat, le 26 Octobre 1928, d'un Chinois inconnu, dans un
terrain vague, derrière le N°171, Yu Yuen road.
3/ Assassinat, le 18 Mai 1929, du nommé TSOU-WEI-SHI (周尉士)
agent informateur du Poste de Commandement de la Gendarmerie de
Woosung-Shanghai, près de la cité Wei-Teh-Li, Burkill road.
4/ Assassinat, le 25 Mai 1929, du nommé CHAO-AH-FOH (陳阿福), agent
informateur du Poste de Commandement de la Gendarmerie de Woo-
sung-Shanghai, au 906, Pingliang road.
5/ Assassinat, le 17 Juin 1929, du nommé JANG-YI-VONG (王文),
étudiant, dans la cité Sien-Ching-Li, Gordon road.
6/ Assassinat, le 1er Novembre 1929, du nommé TSANG-CHENG-HENG
(張成恩), agent informateur du Bureau de la Sécurité Publique
et d'une femme TSU-CHIE-ZE (朱氏), au N°523, Medhurst road.
7/ Assassinat, le 11 Novembre 1929, du nommé PEI-SHING (白鑫),
ancien membre du Parti Communiste Chinois, passé en 1923 du
côté du Kuomintang et de quatre personnes de son entourage,
cité Ou-Ho-Fang, Avenue Joffre.
8/ Attentat organisé le 28 Janvier 1930 contre le nommé CHANG-TING-
YIH (張定益), 1007, Cartor road.

物证检验——

在案发现场房间内发现了七枚7.65口径子弹壳：一枚在女子头部右侧的床上，一枚在书桌上，五枚在地板上。

经国际巡捕房鉴定，用于刺杀张方石（CHANG-FANG-SHOK）及其妻子的其中一把手枪，曾在1928年至1934年间用于实施14起政治犯罪。清单如下：
1/ 1928年9月4日，在爱文义路祥福里策划袭击前共产党员王招君（JANG-TSAO-KUIN）。
2/ 1928年10月26日，在愚园路171号后方的一块空地上，刺杀一名身份不明的中国人。
3/ 1929年5月18日，在伯基尔路维德里附近，刺杀吴淞上海宪兵司令部情报员周尉士（TSOU-WEI-SHI）。
4/ 1929年5月25日，在平凉路906号，刺杀吴淞上海宪兵司令部情报员陈阿福（CHAO-AH-FOH）。
5/ 1929年6月17日，在戈登路仙庆里，刺杀学生王文（JANG-YI-VONG）。
6/ 1929年11月1日，在麦赫斯特路523号，刺杀公共保安局情报员张成恩（TSANG-CHENG-HENG）及一名女子朱氏（TSU-CHIE-ZE）。
7/ 1929年11月11日，在霞飞路欧霍坊，刺杀前中国共产党党员、1923年投靠国民党的白鑫（PEI-SHING）及其四名随从。
8/ 1930年1月28日，在卡托路1007号，策划袭击张定益（CHANG-TING-YIH）。

9/ Assassinat, le 14 Avril 1930, d'un Chinois inconnu dans la
cité Yong-Ching-Li, Avenue road.
10/ Assassinat, le 19 Novembre 1932, du nommé T. IU-TSE-YEU
(周子猷), au N°1046, Ze-Veng-Li, Tatung road.
11/ Assassinat, le 25 Novembre 1932, d'un agent secret du Bureau
de la Sécurité Publique, WANG-ZU-HSI (王祖喜) et attentat
contre trois hommes et une femme, au N°1040, Ze-Veng-Li, Tatung
road.
12/ Assassinat, le 4 Mai 1933, du nommé OU-KUIN-YONG, dans l'Avenue
Haig. Cette personne prise pour WANG-YONG-HUA, ex-délégué spé-
cial du Comité Central du Parti Kuomintang, fut tuée par erreur.
13/ Assassinat, le 14 Juin 1933, de MA-SHAO-WU, ex-délégué spécial
du Comité Central du Parti Kuomintang.
14/ Assassinat, le 25 Août 1933, du nommé WANG-YONG-HUA, agent du
même service que MA-SHAO-WU, à l'Hôtel "Sun-Sun".

Mobiles du crime -

M. CHENG-FANG-SHEK (陳芳巷) alias CHENG-YIH-MING (陳一民)
alias CHENG-TAI-SENG (陳泰生) était âgé de 33 ans. Il était natif
du Kiangsu. Ancien élève de l'Ecole Secondaire "Tseng-Hwa" à Wuchow,
il se serait affilié à la "Ligue des Jeunesses Communistes Chinoi-
ses" en 1925. En 1926, il aurait été envoyé par le Parti Communiste
Chinois à Moscou où il aurait étudié à l'Université Sun-Yat-Sen.
C'est au cours de son séjour dans la capitale de l'URSS qu'il se
maria avec LIU-KIE, qui serait également communiste. De cette union,
naquit une fille. Après son retour en Chine en 1930, CHENG changea
de nom et se fit appeler CHENG-FANG-SHEK. Il aurait occupé le pos-
te de secrétaire du Bureau de Propagande du Comité Provincial du
Kiangsu du Parti Communiste Chinois. Il aurait été également membre
actif du NOPR et de la "Ligue des Ecrivains Radicaux Chinois" (or-
ganisation auxiliaire du Parti Communiste Chinois). Il se serait
page_data.zh:
342/5 - 4

9/ 1930年4月14日，在爱文义路永庆里，刺杀一名身份不明的中国人。
10/ 1932年11月19日，在大通路泽丰里1046号，刺杀周子猷（T. IU-TSE-YEU）。
11/ 1932年11月25日，在大通路泽丰里1040号，刺杀公共保安局秘密特工王祖喜（WANG-ZU-HSI），并袭击三男一女。
12/ 1933年5月4日，在海格大道刺杀欧桂荣（OU-KUIN-YONG）。此人被误认为是国民党前中央特派员王永华，遭误杀。
13/ 1933年6月14日，刺杀国民党前中央特派员马绍武（MA-SHAO-WU）。
14/ 1933年8月25日，在“新新”旅馆，刺杀与马绍武同属一个机构的特工王永华（WANG-YONG-HUA）。

作案动机——

张方巷（CHENG-FANG-SHEK），又名张一民（CHENG-YIH-MING），又名张泰生（CHENG-TAI-SENG），享年33岁。江苏籍。曾是梧州“振华”中学的学生，据称于1925年加入“中国共产主义青年团”。1926年，据称被中国共产党派往莫斯科，在孙逸仙大学学习。在苏联首都期间，他与同样据称为共产党员的刘杰结婚。婚后育有一女。1930年返回中国后，张改名换姓，自称张方石。据称他曾担任中国共产党江苏省委员会宣传部秘书。据称他也是“左联”（NOPR）和“中国左翼作家联盟”（中国共产党的辅助组织）的活跃成员。据称他后来

page_data.en:
342/3. - 8

séparé ensuite du Parti Communiste Chinois. Ces derniers temps,
il collaborait à plusieurs revues et journaux de Shanghai :
"Central China Daily News" (中華日報), organe de Mr. WANG-CHING
WEI, "Revue Mensuelle Lao-Kung-Yuh-Pao" (勞工月報), "Shanghai Mei
Pao" (上海美報), "Oriental Review" (東方雜誌), etc....
CHENG-PING-HO-HOK était venu habiter au N°64, cité Zeu-Foh-Li,
Route Say-Zoeng, vers la fin d'Avril 1934.Ses adresses antérieures
étaient :
1/ En Janvier 1934 - N°9, cité Sai-Hu-Li, Ferry road, maison du
nommé LI-KUEI-YING, âgé de 50 ans, médecin.
2/ En Février et Mars 1934 - une chambre située au dessus de
l'Ecole "Tse-Sio", cité Zeu-Foh-Li, Route Say-Zoeng.

CHENG-PING-HOK menait une vie très modeste. Il ne sortait
que rarement et ne recevait personne chez lui. Il n'autorisait
même pas que les enfants du voisinage jouassent avec sa fillette.
Parmi les rares connaissances de CHENG, se trouvait le nommé
WANG-TAO-NAN (王道南), âgé de 34 ans, natif du Kiangsi,ancien
sous-préfet de la province du Kiangsi, actuellement sans situation.
M. WANG avait fait ses études dans le même collège "Tseng-Wu" que
CHENG. Les deux camarades se séparèrent en 1923. Ce n'est qu'au
début du mois de Mai 1934 qu'ils se seraient rencontrés par hasard
dans l'Avenue Joffre. Sur l'invitation de CHENG, ils allèrent dîner
dans un restaurant chinois à l'enseigne "Zu-Fong-Yu", Tchekiang
road. En se séparant, CHENG ne donna pas son adresse à WANG. Le
8 Juin 1934, WANG, pour remercier CHENG, du repas qu'il lui avait
offert, lui envoya sa carte de visite au journal "Tseng-Hua",303,C
Honan road,pour l'inviter à un dîner. A ce dîner qui eut lieu le
6 Juin, assistaient, en dehors de CHENG, quelques amis de WANG
qu'il avait invités pour leur demander de lui trouver une situa-
tion. Aucun des invités n'avait connu CHENG auparavant.
page_data.zh:
342/3. - 8

脱离了中国共产党。近期，他为上海的多家报刊杂志撰稿，包括汪精卫先生的机关报《中华日报》、《劳工月报》、《上海美报》、《东方杂志》等……

张平鹤（CHENG-PING-HO-HOK）于1934年4月底搬入萨宗路朱福里64号居住。他此前的住址为：
1/ 1934年1月——斐伦路赛华里9号，50岁医生李桂英（LI-KUEI-YING）的住宅。
2/ 1934年2月和3月——萨宗路朱福里“慈孝”学校楼上的一间房间。

张平鹤生活非常简朴。他很少外出，也不在家接待客人。他甚至不允许邻居的孩子和他的女儿一起玩耍。在张的少数熟人中，有一位名叫王道南（WANG-TAO-NAN）的人，34岁，江西籍，前江西省副县长，目前无业。王先生曾与张在同一所“文武”学院求学。两位同学于1923年分手。直到1934年5月初，他们才在霞飞路偶然相遇。应张的邀请，他们去浙江路一家名为“聚丰园”的中餐馆共进晚餐。分别时，张未将地址告知王。1934年6月8日，王为感谢张请客，向河南路303号C座的《中华》报社寄去名片，邀请张共进晚餐。这次晚餐于6月6日举行，除张之外，还有王邀请的几位朋友出席，目的是请他们帮忙谋职。这些客人中此前无人认识张。

page_data.en:
342/□ - □

Etant donné les résultats de l'expertise faite sur les pro-
jectiles saisis sur les lieux du crime, il y a tout lieu de croi-
re que l'assassinat de CHENG et de sa femme est l'oeuvre d'agents
du Parti communiste chinois./.
page_data.zh:

------------------------------------------------------------------

Information on Cheng Fang Sha assassinated by the
Chinese C.P.U.

We are informed that CHENG TSH SENG(陳德森)
alias CHENG FANG SHA(陳芳若) was a native of Hupeh.

Cheng was a former student of the "Wuhan"
secondary school at Wuchow. In 1925 he joined the
Chinese Communist Youth League, and in 1926 he was sent
by the party to Moscow, where he studied at the Sun Yat
Sen University. During the course of his stay in the
capital of the U.S.S.R., he married Liu Kie(劉傑),
also a communist. From this union a little girl was
born. After his return to China in 1930, he changed
his name and was known as Cheng Fang Sha.

At one time, Cheng was the Secretary of the
Propaganda Department of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee.
He was also an active member of the MOPR and of the
Chinese Radical Writers' League (an auxiliary organisation
of the Chinese Communist Party).

This information, which emanates from a secret
source, is given under the usual reserve.

TRANSLATION FROM FRENCH POLICE REPORT DATED 9.6.1934.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Assassination of CHENG FANG SHA, Chinese journalist.

On June 8, 1934 Cheng Fang Sha (陳芳若), journlist,
aged 28, and Lu Kie (劉 傑 ), aged 32, his wife were
assassinated at No. 64 Cheng Tseng Li (長富里), Route Say
Zoong.
The assassins, who were three in number, entered the
alleyway at about 8.30 a.m. Two of them carrying baskets
of fruit in their hands, entered the room whilst the
third watched outside.
Cheng was killed by two bullets, whilst the woman bore
marks of having been hit five times.
The assassins, having accomplished their crime, made
good their escape before the Police were informed by the
tenants of the house.
Cheng studied at the Sun Yat Sen University in Moscow
and spoke fluent Russian. He was formerly a member of
the Chinese Communist Party but had severed his connections.
He was a contributor to several reviews and Chinese news-
papers in Shanghai, such as the Central China Daily News,
the organ of Waung Ching Wei, Lo Kong Yue Monthly Review,
Shanghai Van Pao, Oriental Review, etc.
During the course of enquiries it has been established
that one of the pistols used by the assassins was the same
that was employed in the murder on May 4, 1933 of
Mr. Pu Kuei Yogn on Avenue Haig. This person, mistaken
for Wong Yung Hwa, ex-Nanking Political Agent , and former
comrade of Ma Shao Wu, was killed in error.
It is also to be recalled that Wong was in turn ass-
assinated at the Sun Sun Hotel on August 25, 1933.
There is thus every reason to believe that the assass-
ination of the Cheng couple is a new act of vengeance of
the C.C.P. with regard to the party's traitors.

S.S.
Information.
ABR 11/6
(批：July 30)

中国记者程芳若遇刺案。

1934年6月8日，28岁的记者程芳若 (Cheng Fang Sha) 及其32岁的妻子刘杰 (Lu Kie) 在萨珠路 (Route Say Zoong) 长富里 (Cheng Tseng Li) 64号遇刺身亡。
三名刺客于上午8时30分左右进入弄堂。其中两人手提水果篮进入房间，第三人在外望风。
程身中两弹身亡，其妻身上有五处枪伤痕迹。
刺客作案后，在住户报警前已顺利逃脱。
程曾在莫斯科孙逸仙大学求学，能讲流利的俄语。他曾是中共党员，但已断绝关系。他是上海多家中文报刊的撰稿人，如汪精卫机关报《华中日报》、《罗宫月月刊》、《上海晚报》、《东方评论》等。
经调查证实，刺客使用的手枪之一，与1933年5月4日在海格路谋杀浦桂永 (Pu Kuei Yogn) 先生所用的是同一支。浦先生被误认为是前南京政治特工、马绍武的前同志黄荣华 (Wong Yung Hwa)，因而遭错杀。
还需指出的是，黄荣华随后于1933年8月25日在新新旅馆遇刺身亡。
因此，有充分理由相信，程氏夫妇遇刺案是中共针对党内叛徒实施的又一起报复行动。

S.S.
情报。

5.36

Author And
Wife Shot To

Three Gunmen Enter To
Present Gifts, Fire
On Sleeping Pair

TRAGEDY SAID ALLIED
WITH COMMUNISTS

Murdered Man Had Been
Writer For Various
Chinese Magazines

Mr. Chen Fan-lo, 28, a
Chinese writer, and his
wife were riddled with
bullets and instantly killed
yesterday morning as they
lay in their bed on the
third floor of a Route de
Say Zoong residence. Three
men dressed in working
clothes, believed to be the
slayers, made a clean escape
while a watchman and
crowds in Shan Fu Alley
below knew nothing of the
tragedy until Shiao Lien-
tze, 5-year-old daughter, ran
screaming from her parents'
sleeping room.

The crime was daring as it was
brutal. The landlord of the place
said that about 8.30 a.m. three
men, evidently of the working
class, came with presents for Mr.
and Mrs. Chen and were allowed
to go upstairs. Shortly afterwards
he heard the shots and as he ran
upstairs the three men forced
their way out. He found the
couple in their bed, shot in eight
places. Both were dead.

The alley watchman said that
he with others nearby heard the
explosions but attributed them to
firecrackers. He recalled also that
when the three men entered the
house he saw five or six others
waiting outside the rear door.

Reliable Chinese sources allied
the crime with Communistic
elements. It was said that Mr.

28岁的中国作家陈范洛 (Chen Fan-lo) 先生及其妻子昨天早晨在萨珠路一处住宅三楼的床上被子弹打得千疮百孔，当场死亡。三名身穿工人服装的男子（被认为是凶手）干净利落地逃脱，而楼下善富里的更夫和人群直到他们5岁的女儿萧连子 (Shiao Lien-tze) 尖叫着从父母卧室跑出来时，才得知这一悲剧。

这起犯罪既大胆又残忍。该处房东称，上午8时30分左右，三名显然是工人阶级的男子带着给陈氏夫妇的礼物前来，并被允许上楼。不久后他听到枪声，当他跑上楼时，三名男子强行冲出。他发现夫妇俩躺在床上，身中八枪。两人均已死亡。

弄堂更夫称，他和附近其他人听到了爆炸声，但以为是鞭炮声。他还回忆说，当那三名男子进入屋内时，他看到后门外还有五六个人在等候。

可靠的与中国方面有关的来源将此事与共产主义分子联系起来。据说陈先生是多家讨论国际和国内事务的中文杂志的撰稿人。他最近的文章包括《希特勒崛起后的第二国际》和《美苏恢复外交关系之后》。

法国警察正在调查此案。

Acting on the authority of a warrant issued at
the instance of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, the
Municipal Police on June 7, 1934, arrested in the Dah
Yoong (大用) Rubber Factory, 1 Unining Road, a
communist suspect named Heuh Kyi (霍機).

The accused appeared before court on June 8 when
the case against him was remanded until June 13.

Ex-Communists Assassinated in French Concession

On June 8, 1934, one Chen Fang Cha (陳芳查), journalist
age 28, and Liu Chih (劉志), age 32, his wife, were
assassinated at No.64 San Fu Li (善富里), Route de Say
Zoong. The assassins who were three in number, entered
the alleyway at about 8.30 a.m. Two of them carrying
baskets of fruit in their hands, entered the room and
opened fire on the Chen couple, the man being hit twice
and the woman five times.

Chen studied in Sung Yat Sen University in Moscow and
was formerly a member of the Chinese Communist Party.
He contributed to Chinese newspapers in Shanghai, such as
the Central China Daily News, Lo Kong Yue Monthly Review
and Oriental Review.

It has been established that one of the pistols used
by the assassins was the same as that employed in the
murder on Avenue Haig on May 4, 1933 of Mr. Pu Kuei Yong
who was mistaken for Hwang Yung Hua, Nanking Political
Agent. Hwang, it will be recalled, was subsequently
assassinated in the Sun Sun Hotel.
